digest.title: Orchestrating Claude Code Agents: The Chief of Staff Pattern
Meta’s Muse is creepy, but maybe not for the reasons you think
digest.tldr: Meta's Muse is apparently an effective AI assistant, but one that's a little creepy.  Part of that is because of its new Mac app, which can access Messages, Calendar, and Notes.
